definitions.explanation: A condition or circumstance that puts one in a worse position.

examples.japanese: この⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{我々|われわれ}→我々：03795_wareware⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不利|ふり}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: These conditions are disadvantageous to us.

examples.japanese: {不利|ふり}な⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}たされた→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: I was put in a disadvantageous position.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被告|ひこく}→被告：11080_hikoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不利|ふり}な⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦きた→くる：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: Evidence unfavorable to the defendant came out.

notes:
{不利|ふり} describes situations, conditions, or positions that work against someone's interests. It functions as both a noun and na-adjective.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {不利|ふり}な⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧ (unfavorable conditions)
- Predicate: 〜に{不利|ふり}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (to be disadvantageous to ~)
- Noun: {不利|ふり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{被|こうむ}る→被る：18070_koumuru⟧ (to suffer a disadvantage)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不利|ふり}な⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧: disadvantageous position
- {不利|ふり}な⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧: unfavorable situation
- {不利|ふり}な⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧: incriminating evidence
- {不利|ふり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work against (someone)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{不利益|ふりえき}→不利益：11481_furieki⟧: disadvantage, harm (noun)
- Antonym: ⟦{有利|ゆうり}→有利：03651_yuuri⟧ (advantageous, favorable)
